AvgPartition.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the instance by storing the provided list and limit values directly into object fields." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance being initialized."
        <REF> lst </REF>: data_type "The input list value to store on the instance."
        <REF> limit </REF>: data_type "The input limit value to store on the instance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the input parameter lst directly to the instance field self.lst. RESULT self.lst]
            [COMMAND Assign the input parameter limit directly to the instance field self.limit. RESULT self.limit]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AvgPartition.setNum:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes and returns the quotient and remainder obtained by dividing the length of self.lst by self.limit." setNum]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.lst </REF>: sequence "The stored list-like sequence whose length is used as the dividend."
        <REF> self.limit </REF>: number "The divisor used to split the sequence length into a full-group count and a remainder."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> size </REF>: integer "The floor-division quotient of len(self.lst) divided by self.limit."
        <REF> remainder </REF>: integer "The modulo remainder of len(self.lst) divided by self.limit."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute size as len(self.lst) floor-divided by self.limit. RESULT size]
            [COMMAND Compute remainder as len(self.lst) modulo self.limit. RESULT remainder]
            [COMMAND Return the tuple containing size and remainder. RESULT size, remainder]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: self.limit is 0 when evaluating either the floor-division or modulo operation.]
        [LOG "Division by zero occurs while computing the quotient and remainder from len(self.lst) and self.limit."]
        [THROW ZeroDivisionError "Raised because the method divides and takes modulo by self.limit when self.limit is zero."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AvgPartition.get:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Compute the start and end bounds of the indexed partition using the base size and remainder from self.setNum(), extend the partition by one when the index falls within the remainder allotment, and return the corresponding slice of self.lst." get]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> index </REF>: integer "The zero-based partition index used to compute the slice boundaries."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list_slice "The contiguous slice of self.lst corresponding to the computed partition for the given index."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.setNum() and unpack its two returned values into size and remainder. RESULT size_remainder]
            [COMMAND Compute start as index multiplied by size plus min(index, remainder). RESULT start]
            [COMMAND Compute end as start plus size. RESULT end]
            [COMMAND If index + 1 is less than or equal to remainder, increase end by 1. RESULT adjusted_end]
            [COMMAND Return the slice self.lst[start:end], using start as the inclusive lower bound and end as the exclusive upper bound. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
